title: Song of Time
note: A slow chant in three. Play it as a drone: one soft strum or a slow picked chord per bar and let it ring into the next. The G major bar is the bright Dorian colour of the piece, and C to Dm closes the phrase. The tune itself is left out.
remarks: The original (Temple of Time) is an unaccompanied chant: the Hooktheory tab has no chords. Sourced: D Dorian, three-four, 72. The backing is my own fit, a Dm drone with the Dorian IV and a VII to i close, chords Hooktheory lists for the mode. The eight-bar phrase is my count. No chord chart could be reached.
